title: Audit R1 corrections to the governed async replan provider — bounded concurrent driver, settle/delivery stale-generation revalidation, zero-budget proof, production-composition integration test (flag unchanged, default OFF)
description: Audit R1 on PR #118. F1: the driver awaited each claimed generation sequentially and the production busy flag serialized sweeps behind it — a stalled provider call starved pending rows. Now the whole per-sweep bound is claimed up front (oldest-first; CAS lease+epoch stays single-flight authority) and claimed generations run concurrently; the busy flag is removed so overlapping sweeps claim newly-minted rows. F2: settle() re-proves unresolved slot, live recovery identity and durable deadline inside its transaction; requestCandidate() revalidates at delivery and converges stale sibling rows for the bound recovery, committing terminal transitions before serving so a thrown code never rolls them back — cancelled/expired/superseded/slot-resolved rows can never become consumable. F3: ZERO_BUDGET pinned at the real admission seam — cap=0 blocks positive envelopes (BUDGET_EXCEEDED) and unprovable cost (UNVERIFIED), provable $0 admits CAPPED with a real 0µUSD reservation, absent policy resolves UNCAPPED, no lineage NONE; PR #117 semantics unchanged. F4: new win32 baselines narrowed to the exact failing titles (4 passing ingest-adjacent tests stay unmasked); H1/H2 integration composes the real pool, cost admission, driver and runtime with only model transport stubbed, proven through atomic commit; synthetic E2E stays in A–G.
